name: uilscuola-roma-lazio
description: Sistema gestione anagrafica iscritti sindacato Roma e Lazio

scripts.dev: node build.js && wrangler pages dev dist --d1=sindacato-db --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.dev:sandbox: node build.js && wrangler pages dev dist --d1=sindacato-db --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed
scripts.git:init: git init && git add . && git commit -m 'Initial commit'
